info.title: QuickBooks Online
info.description: Connect to QuickBooks Online to manage customers, vendors, invoices, bills, payments, items, and financial reports. Sync accounting data with your business applications.

get.description: Retrieves a specific account by ID. Returns account details including type, balance, and classification.
Generates an Aged Payables (AP Aging) report showing outstanding vendor balances by age.
Generates an Aged Receivables (AR Aging) report showing outstanding customer balances by age.
Generates a Balance Sheet report showing assets, liabilities, and equity as of a specific date.
Retrieves a specific bill by ID. Returns full bill details including vendor, line items, due date, and balance.
Retrieves a specific bill payment by ID. Returns payment details including vendor, amount, payment type, and linked bills.
Generates a Statement of Cash Flows report showing cash inflows and outflows from operations, investing, and financing.
Returns all entities that have been created, updated, or deleted since the specified date. Use for incremental sync operations. Maximum lookback period is 30 days.

parameters.name: entities
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of entity types (e.g., Customer,Invoice,Payment)

get.description: Retrieves company information including name, address, and settings. Use the realmId as the id parameter.
Retrieves a specific credit memo by ID. Returns details including line items, remaining credit, and linked transactions.
Retrieves a specific customer by their QuickBooks ID. Returns full customer details including contact info, addresses, balance, and settings.
Generates a report showing current balance for each customer.
Retrieves a specific deposit by ID.
Retrieves a specific employee by ID.
Retrieves a specific estimate by ID. Returns full estimate details including line items, totals, status, and expiration date.
Downloads the estimate as a PDF file using the company's estimate template.
Generates a General Ledger report showing all transactions by account.
Retrieves a specific invoice by ID. Returns full invoice details including line items, totals, balance due, and linked transactions.
Downloads the invoice as a PDF file. The PDF uses the company's invoice template settings.
Retrieves a specific product or service item by ID. Returns full details including pricing, accounts, and inventory levels.
Retrieves a specific journal entry by ID.
Retrieves a specific payment by ID. Returns payment details including amount, customer, deposit account, and linked invoices.
Retrieves company preferences including accounting settings, sales forms, and email settings.
Generates a Profit and Loss (Income Statement) report for the specified date range. Shows revenue, expenses, and net income.
Retrieves a specific purchase/expense by ID.
Retrieves a specific purchase order by ID.
Retrieves a specific refund receipt by ID.
Retrieves a specific sales receipt by ID. Returns full details including line items, payment method, and deposit account.
Downloads the sales receipt as a PDF file.
Generates a list of all transactions for the specified date range. Can filter by transaction type.
Retrieves a specific transfer by ID.
Generates a Trial Balance report showing debit and credit balances for all accounts.
Retrieves a specific vendor by their QuickBooks ID. Returns full vendor details including contact info, address, balance, and 1099 status.
Generates a report showing current balance owed to each vendor.
Retrieves a specific vendor credit by ID.
Execute SQL-like queries against QuickBooks data. Supports Customer, Vendor, Invoice, Bill, Payment, Item, Account, and more. Example: SELECT * FROM Customer WHERE Active = true MAXRESULTS 100

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: SQL-like query string (e.g., SELECT * FROM Invoice WHERE TotalAmt > '1000')

post.description: Execute up to 30 create, update, delete, or query operations in a single API request. Each operation in the batch is processed independently.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Batch request containing up to 30 operations

CustomerRef.description: Reference to a customer. Get the Id from Query or GetCustomer.

VendorRef.description: Reference to a vendor. Get the Id from Query or GetVendor.

ItemRef.description: Reference to an item. Get the Id from Query or GetItem.

AccountRef.description: Reference to an account. Get the Id from Query or GetAccount.
